segments.text: for the yogi who is fully aware of matrika-chakra, matrika-chakra-samboda-wata, for him Shirdi-ram-havi,
all the bodies become offerings in the fire of consciousness, in the fire of God-consciousness,
not all the bodies, all the establishment of eye consciousness, eye consciousness on bodies,
Pramatri-bhav, Pramatri-bhav means eye consciousness.
When eye consciousness is established on gross body, in that way he experiences,
sees that I am this body, I am this gross body, I am this subtle body, I am this subtlest body,
subtle body in dreaming state, subtlest body in dreamless state, sound sleep.
All these three bodies are called three whales, three coverings.
When you establish eye consciousness in them, you should establish, remove eye consciousness
from these three states of bodies, gross, subtle and subtlest.
Eye consciousness on gross body makes you perceive that I am the possessor of Jagracharya.
I am, I am this body, I am this gross body, and in the same way in dreaming state also,
I am this body of dreaming state, in dreamless sound sleep also, in sociality, I am this body.
So, Abhimanyan, Ahambhav or eye consciousness on these three bodies is called Shirdi-ram.
For such a yogi, all these three bodies including eye consciousness,
become offerings, become offerings, heavy offerings in the fire of God consciousness.
He offers this eye consciousness on these three bodies in the fire of God consciousness,
by which way all these three eye consciousnesses become one with that God consciousness.
Sarvayriyat pramad tritena abhishektam, tul sukshma desorupam shariram,
tat mahayogina prasmin jidhagna hu imanam havi.
All the worldly people who have abhishektam, abhishekt means inaugurated by inserting one's consciousness.
One's eye-ness, inauguration of eye consciousness.
When you inaugurate or insert your eye consciousness on these bodies, that I am this body,
I am this dreaming body of dreaming state, I am the body of dreamless state,
that is abhishektam, and those bodies are tul sukshma desorupam shariram.
Gross, subtle and subtlest, gross body is found in wakefulness,
subtle body is found in dreaming state, and subtlest body is found in dreamless state.
All these three ways of consciousness is for great yogi, mahayogina prasmin jidhagna hu imanam havi.
Prasmin jidhagna hu, because he offers this, he makes it digest in the fire of God consciousness,
so that no other consciousness remains, only God consciousness, only he finds the kingdom of God consciousness everywhere,
in a gross body, in subtle body and in subtlest body.
Shri Rupra matrita prasminena sadaiva chin pramatra chin matrita avini visita toad,
because he subsides. This way he subsides, Shri Rupra matrita.
He subsides eye consciousness on these three-fold bodies.
Eye consciousness on these three-fold bodies is subsided, get subsided.
And chin matrita avini visita toad and he gets entry, he gets entry in the God consciousness.
Chin pramatra chin matrita avini visita toad. This is said in Shri Rupra matrita toad.
Mahashunyale vahnav, bhuta ki visyadikam huyate manasasakam sohoma sruk chetara.
In the fire of great awareness, Mahashunyale, in the fire of great awareness,
when all the five elements, Panchamahabutas, all the organs and all the perceptions of organs are offered,
including one's mind, manasasakam. That is in real sense called havan.
That is supposed to be great havan, great jege, where offering spoon, sruk means offering spoon,
by which you offer all these substances in that great awareness of fire,
fire of consciousness. Offering spoon, there is awareness, chetana.
Chetana means awareness. You have to offer it with awareness. Awareness is the only way, how to offer it.
Timurodgata api, in Timurodgata tantra, it is also said, the one who is very beloved to you,
the one who is your friend, who is your closely relative, who is your giver of all happiness,
who is your valabha. Valabha means most loud, mostly loud person.
Tatanga Bhakshana Devi, when you subside, all these attachments in the fire of God consciousness,
then Gagana Angana Yatpatait, one is situated in the yard of supreme consciousness,
supreme ether. Gagana Angana, Angara means yard. Yard of supreme ether appears to him.
Yard of supreme ether of awareness. Atrihi Dehpramadita Prashamana-bhya-vipindartha,
in essence, it is just to subside on these threefold bodies, oneness of eye consciousness.
Eye consciousness on these threefold bodies should get subsided.
It is also said in Bhagavad Gita, Sarvanindra Yikarmani, Pranakarmani Chaapare,
Atma Samyamayoga, Gana Ujjuhati, Gana Deepita.
All the actions of organs of senses and all the actions of breathing,
and when all these actions are juhati or offered or put completely in the fire of Atma Samyamayoga,
in the fire of one-pointedness of God consciousness.
This is the way of action of great yogis.
Spandetu, in Spanda also, this is narrated, this point, Yadak Shobha Priliyeta Tadashya Parmum Padam.
When all-round agitation takes an end, when all agitations are over,
then supreme state of God consciousness is revealed.
Agitation here, in this Shloka, Throbo Deha, the Aham Prati Rupa,
agitation means to put your eye consciousness on these threefold bodies.
When that eye consciousness on these threefold bodies is removed,
and that eye consciousness is inserted in that God consciousness,
then agitation is over, and there is no further agitation.
Till then agitation is there.
Yadak Shobha Pratav Bhattashi Kalata has explained the meaning of agitation this way,
in the commentary of Spanda.
